Implied by the GM's newest words: 'make the plan, then do the lane law as task one, work that under the checklist with a retro afterwards' - the lane law is task one, so the tooling is not. The substance is kept (T01 has its Approach block; the event log records T01 regardless and the split is replayed from it), so FR-005 is whole.

decisions.summary: The rule table first: one row per LAW entry and per lanes_breaking rule, class R/G/O, verdict kept / made obstruction-aware / merged / retired.
decisions.why: 384 US0's Independent Test verbatim. LAW's 28 entries re-counted at law.py:854.

decisions.summary: D3 is the first edit; the baseline (D6) is taken with D3 in place.
decisions.why: A measurement-order choice. 'D3 changes no lane' is a premise, so D6 must show it: the HEAD+D3 cohort's pass/fail set compared seed by seed with m:w156-redeal-cohort's (or HEAD's in a detached worktree), not called 'HEAD' on assumption.

decisions.why: 384 US0's test admits a refusal 'named by a rule the table keeps'; field_unreached is not an angle rule and T03 is the spec's own task for the four seeds.

decisions.summary: If seed 21's named rules are not angle or doubling rules, stop at part B before writing D2/D4.
decisions.why: A pause to re-approach, not a drop: D2 and D4 stay owed by FR-000 whatever seed 21 shows.

decisions.summary: 'Forced' reads the ground a lane may not cross: steading built ground, fixtures, solid boxes, crop and water, indexed once.
decisions.why: The principle (the ground a lane may not cross) is the GM's 'an obstruction on the map'. Groves and the commons are out because the law lets a lane cross them (steading_footprints' claim) - D1's table should say so at the row.

decisions.summary: A turn is forced when the chord past it, swept at lane width, crosses that ground; a meeting is forced when the sliver between the arriving leg and the tread, back NEEDLE_FT, holds it.
decisions.why: A broader meeting is reached by turning toward the tread earlier, through that sliver; ground there is what blocks the wider approach (US0's test). Open ground is judged as today.

decisions.summary: The filter is applied at the manifest-judging functions and lanes_breaking, not in the pure detectors; repair passes read and filtered where they would still cut a forced shape.
decisions.why: Implementation placement; makes the angle rules obstruction-aware as FR-000 asks.

decisions.summary: lanes_breaking returns {lane: [rule names]}; refuse_unmended names the rules.
decisions.why: Serves US0's test ('named by a rule the table keeps'); a XIV fix.

decisions.summary: A needle over open ground is merged by the existing tails.along_tail / cut_at_tail cut, asked at NEEDLE_DEG.
decisions.why: The GM's ruling that two paths side by side become one; reusing a mechanism is a design choice.

decisions.summary: 'A needle the cut cannot mend (it would strand a house or a tree lane's reach) stays a violation, named by D3.'
decisions.why: 384 US0: 'two lanes that run nearly side by side are merged into one path, never refused'; FR-000: 'merged into one path rather than refused'. D4 itself calls an unforced needle the side-by-side case, and a violation in lanes_breaking feeds the last resort and refuse_unmended, so this is 'merged, except where cut_at_tail cannot do it'. The stated reason is the mechanism ('reuse, not a new pass'), which is implementation cost; merging is not physically impossible where the cut would strand something - cut the other lane, or re-root what hangs on the cut stretch onto the shared tread, so the two run as one tread to where they part. No case is measured where no merge exists. US0's 'named by a rule the table keeps' does not cover it: the needle's verdict is obstruction-aware/merged, not kept. Purpose-fatal: a seed is refused for a path shape the ground explains.

decisions.summary: No threshold changes value, no rule outside the angle and doubling rules changes, no homestead/fixture/seat moves; a rule describing no walker's behavior is retired only with its reason.
decisions.why: FR-000's treatments (obstruction-aware, merged, retired with reason) are all admitted; refining a number is an exit the request offers, weighed and declined in A6(a) with a reason; nothing placed earlier moves (GM 2026-10-02, 2026-10-17).
